NVDA.name: NVIDIA Corporation
NVDA.ai_strategy_one_line_zh: 以CUDA全栈平台为核心，通过数据中心级软硬件协同设计提供AI基础设施。
NVDA.ai_strategy_one_line_en: Full-stack, datacenter-scale AI infrastructure platform with CUDA software and co-designed hardware to power AI models, agents, and enterprise workloads.
concrete_bets: Platform strategy: hardware, systems, software, AI models, services

MSFT.name: Microsoft Corporation
MSFT.ai_strategy_one_line_zh: 以负责任的方式普及AI，打造智能云与Copilot智能体平台，赋能企业全面提升生产力。
MSFT.ai_strategy_one_line_en: Broadly and responsibly deliver AI via the intelligent cloud and Copilot agent platform to transform enterprise productivity.

PLTR.name: Palantir Technologies Inc.
PLTR.ai_strategy_one_line_zh: 以本体论为核心，通过AIP平台将生成式AI安全集成到政府与企业运营决策中
PLTR.ai_strategy_one_line_en: Integrate generative AI into enterprise and government operations via AIP built on Ontology
concrete_bets: LLM integration across Gotham and Foundry

META.name: Meta Platforms, Inc.
META.ai_strategy_one_line_zh: 以Meta AI为核心，将AI技术融入全系应用与AI眼镜，驱动内容推荐与沉浸式社交体验。
META.ai_strategy_one_line_en: Embedding Meta AI across apps and AI glasses to power ranking, discovery, and immersive social experiences.
concrete_bets: Meta AI assistant across apps, web, and AI glasses
AI-powered content ranking and discovery engine
Reality Labs long-term AI and AR hardware research

themes.evidence_one_line_zh: OpenAI案例集中展示企业用AI降本增效、改造工作流的具体成果。
themes.evidence_one_line_en: OpenAI case studies show enterprises cutting costs and reworking workflows with AI.

themes.evidence_one_line_zh: 涵盖智能体行为、推理模式控制、信念更新与智能体隐私安全等研究。
themes.evidence_one_line_en: Covers agent behavior, reasoning control, belief updating, and agentic privacy/security.

themes.evidence_one_line_en: Covers GPU scheduling, edge multimodal, ASR/TTS, and image/video generation.
